findings.title: Queries interpolated twice in shard path (shard + runSplitQuery)
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery applies applyTemplateVariables, then each sub-request goes to runSplitQuery, which applies applyTemplateVariables again. Ad-hoc filters (request.filters) can be added to the expression twice. The second pass also runs on expressions that already carry injected shard selectors and `| drop __stream_shard__`. The test confirms this: it expects 5 calls to applyTemplateVariables for a single query. Interpolation should happen in only one place, or the sub-request filters should be cleared before delegating.
